Saved us in our time of need ...
Feb 2017 • Couples
After a bus ride from hell all the way from Kampot, Cambodia, we arrived at our guesthouse exhausted and starved. We ventured out on to street where this restaurant is found ... overwhelmed by the scene, and just wanting some decent food. One of us is a vegetarian, (me) and I ordered the fried tofu with rice, and while it was spicy, it was tasty given we were in backpacker row. The fish and chips were less satisfying, but still did the trick. Most importantly, we loved the service! In a city with so many excellent restaurants, I doubt we'll return, but they helped us out when we needed a quick, no-nonsense meal. Thank you!
